0022600023.text: The Los Angeles Lakers (4-1, first in the Pacific and third in the West) are on the road against the Golden State Warriors (2-3, 10th in the West), who are riding a two-game winning streak and sit 2 games back in the Pacific. The Lakers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 127-105 win in Los Angeles on October 21, and they also won the 2025-26 series 3-1. The Lakers will be without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot), while the Warriors will be without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery).
